component.name: Plasma Opus
component.summary: Dual-pane file manager for KDE Plasma

description.p: Plasma Opus is a dual-pane file manager for KDE Plasma with power-user workflows built on KDE file operations, Places and settings.

ul.li: Browse side-by-side or stacked panes with tabs, history, session restoration and Details, Icons, Compact, Card or flat views
Copy, move, rename in batches, find duplicates, browse archives and verify checksums with queued, undoable KDE file operations
Compare files and folders, and preview each action before synchronizing local folders
Search local folders or a Baloo index, and save searches and collections
Preview documents and media, browse an image gallery, edit text and edit supported media metadata
Save named workspaces with their locations, layouts and appearance
Embed a Konsole terminal and customize colours, fonts, spacing and effects without changing the desktop's appearance
